claims.content: To create a new individual user account under a selected user group with mandatory information including Group Name, User Name, Password, and Verify Password, ensuring password values match and no duplicate names exist.

goal.raw_text: To create a new individual user account under a selected user group with mandatory information including Group Name, User Name, Password, and Verify Password, ensuring password values match and no duplicate names exist.

claims.content: System Administrator
The system administrator must be logged in and authenticated with appropriate privileges to create User Groups and Individual Users.
At least one User Group must already exist in the system, as the Group Name for a new individual user is selected from an existing User Group.

The system must have master data available for District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town if creating Service Providers (though not directly required for User Account, it reflects system state dependencies).
The system administrator initiates the creation of a new individual user account by selecting an existing User Group and entering mandatory user information.

trigger.raw_text: The system administrator initiates the creation of a new individual user account by selecting an existing User Group and entering mandatory user information.

claims.content: The system administrator selects an existing User Group from which the new individual user will be created.
The system administrator enters the User Name for the new individual user.
The system administrator enters a Password for the new user account.
The system administrator re-enters the same password in the Verify Password field to confirm accuracy.
The system validates that all mandatory fields (Group Name, User Name, Password, Verify Password) are completed.
The system checks whether the entered Password and Verify Password values are equal.
If passwords match and no duplicate User Name or User Group name exists, the system saves the new user information.
If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal, the system shall not save the user information.
If the User Name entered already exists in the system, the system shall not allow creation of the Individual User.

If the Group Name selected corresponds to a User Group that already exists with the same name (during group creation context), the system shall not allow creation — implying naming uniqueness constraint applies across user-related entities.
The new individual user account is successfully created and saved in the system under the selected User Group.
The system ensures that the Password and Verify Password values are equal before saving the user information.
The system enforces uniqueness by not allowing creation of an Individual User with an existing name.
All mandatory fields (Group Name, User Name, Password, Verify Password) have been entered and validated for the new user account.
